name: dftracer_analyze
description: Analysis stage of the dftracer pipeline: dfanalyzer (analyze, list_presets) and the dftracer-utils trace tools (reader, info, event_count, split, stats, aggregator, comparator, view, index, aggregator_mpi, call_tree_mpi) over a run's compact traces, plus compute/I-O/communication overlap analysis; dftracer_analyze_check validates the inputs and outputs. Load to analyze or compare traces, or on 'Failed to open RocksDB ... .dftindex', an empty Layer Breakdown with returncode 0 (posix/dlio preset on a custom-category trace), analyze reporting fewer processes than ranks ran, no u_<layer>_time_proc overlap columns (async_layers empty), or dfanalyzer hanging after 'Cluster teardown'.

history.why: converted from dftracer-agents dfanalyzer_service (analyze, list_presets), dftracer_utils_service analysis/query/core/MPI tools, the dftracer-analyzer agent and the dftracer-overlap-analysis skill
